notes.title: v2.2.1.2 ChangeLog
notes.notes:
* Address the issue of white icons appearing during initial load
* Fix the issue where the quick file navigation feature occasionally fails
* Implemented threaded file operations to prevent UI freezing during large file deletion
* Fix the issue where the box's transparency fails to sync when double-clicking to open a folder inside the map box
* Ensure the text content updates correctly after a rename action
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.2.0.9 Changelog
notes.notes:
* Fixed the issue that Coodesker could not drag files after enabling QQ Quick Transfer
* Resolved the issue where the smart box was not displaying correctly
* Fixed the issue that blank files appeared on the desktop
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.2.0.6 Changelog
notes.notes:
* Mapping box supports changing directories
* Fixed the issue that Coodesker cannot display newly added files after the desktop directory changes
* Resolve the issue of overwrite installation failure
* Fix the issue of the desktop background turning black at startup
* Resolve the crash issue that occurs after waking from sleep mode
* Attempt to fix the crash issue
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.2.0.0 ChangeLog
notes.notes:
* Support device management (the device management interface will be displayed when the number of devices exceeds the limit, and you can unbind them yourself)
* Fixed the issue where the smart box did not automatically hide when losing focus
* Fixed the crash when opening mp4 files
* Fixed the issue where the auto-scroll function did not stop when the mouse was released
* Resolved issue with text cut-off in list mode
* Fixed the issue where the button could still be clicked despite the title bar being hidden
* Fixed the issue where the icons in the box are displayed abnormally when sliding up and down with two fingers on the touchpad in some systems
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.1.0.8 ChangeLog
notes.notes:
* Compatible with Listary
* Compatible with Directory Opus
* Compatible with Wallpaper Engine interactive live wallpapers
* Added option to keep personal settings when uninstalling
* Fix the problem of abnormal function of the top desktop
* Fixed an issue where restarting Explorer failed when updating Coodesker
* Fixed the problem of inconsistent display of files when previewing the seer window using the space bar
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.1.0.5 Changelog
notes.notes:
* Support the customization of rounded corner size
* To create mapping boxes, you can use the Alt key and drag folders onto the desktop
* Refresh the mapping box by using the Ctrl+F5 shortcut
* Optimize the icon refresh and solve the issue with white icons.
* Optimize color settings in theme settings
* Improve the speed of restarting Explorer
* Fixed the issue where pressing F5 or Shift+Ctrl+N does not have any effect
* Resolved the issue where the "organize map box" switch was not functioning properly
* Fixed the problem of disordered box position when arranging icons vertically
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.1.0.5 Changelog
notes.notes:
* Support the customization of rounded corner size

* Resolved the issue where the "organize map box" switch was not functioning properly

notes.title: v2.1.0.4 Changelog
notes.notes:
* The layout backup feature allows you to sort the backup files based on time
* Try to fix the black screen issue on quick startup
* Remove the activation code record to avoid security issues
* Fixed the issue of abnormal scrolling that occurred when clicking the scroll bar using the mouse
* Show custom menu if folder is invalid
* Fixed the issue where the file right-click menu displays abnormally
* Fixed the pop-up error window of continuously deleting files
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.1.0.3 Changelog
notes.notes:
* Optimize repeated initialization
* Fixed the problem of path error when updating Coodesker in Steam
* Fix the problem of being unable to import backup
* Fixed an issue where layout backup settings were displayed incorrectly
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.1.0.2 Changelog
notes.notes:
* Supports light-colored background in the mouse-selected area
* Support box title bar not displaying folder icon
* When the device ID changes, prompt for replacement
* Fixed the issue where the box cannot be scrolled when the trackpad is scrolled
* Fixed the issue where the icon right-click menu is invalid
* Fixed the problem of UI confusion in the settings window
* Fixed the problem where the native menu was missing the arrange box menu items
* The issue with invalid arrangement rules has been resolved
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.0.0.9 ChangeLog
notes.notes:
* Urgently fix the problem of the icon not displaying in the Win11 Canary 26002 environment
* When resizing the box, its size adjusts automatically based on the number of icons.
* Fixed the problem of a crash occurring due to the sorting of groups by time
* Try to fix box rendering overlapping issue
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.0.0.8 Changelog
notes.notes:
* Add a new feature that allows the user to adjust the transparency of the entire box
* Fixed the issue where the background of the box was too light and could not be seen clearly when the desktop was pinned to the top
* Fixed the issue of the abnormal size of the smart box
* Try to fix box rendering overlapping issue
* Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: v2.0.0.7 Changelog
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where Coodesker was unable to activate automatically when opened through Steam

notes.title: v2.0.0.7
notes.notes:
* Display the specific size when dragging to change the size of the box
* When using list mode, show icons instead of thumbnails
* Fixed theme inconsistency issue when double-clicking to view files inside a folder
* Separation of smart box settings
* Smart box supports turning off the blur effect
* Fixed the issue of occasional blank icons
* Fixed some other bugs
